recommendation.evidence_assessment: Insufficient citable evidence in record to support a jurisdiction recommendation.
findings: Reviewer conclusions are unverified because no citable supporting evidence identifiers were supplied.
Cannot endorse a jurisdiction until a targeted Stage-1 data-and-engagement package is generated and reviewed.
objections: The reviewers' negative determinations lack cited evidence and therefore are unsubstantiated.

decision_update.question: Authorize Stage-1 data-and-engagement package to enable jurisdiction selection

proposed_changes.editorial_clarification: Maintain human approval requirement; do not select a jurisdiction until regulator feedback on a Stage-1 package.
proposed_changes.next_action: Program lead to assemble Stage-1 package (GLP large-animal intranasal biodistribution/tox, three GMP-like scale-up runs with draft specs and stability, validated potency/orthogonal QC plan, and regulator briefing) and request pre-IND/Scientific Advice in two jurisdictions; 3-month timeline.

recommendation.recommendation: Approve a timebound Stage-1 data-and-engagement package (nonclinical, CMC, analytical, regulatory/commercial) prior to selecting a jurisdiction.
